say: Let's say Vinícius Júnior leaves Real Madrid this summer. Where should he go?
cap: LET'S SAY VINÍCIUS JÚNIOR LEAVES REAL MADRID THIS SUMMER. WHERE SHOULD HE GO?

say: We checked all 96 clubs in Europe's top five leagues on three things: do they need him, does their style suit him, and would it be a step up for him?
cap: WE CHECKED ALL 96|ninety-six CLUBS IN EUROPE'S TOP FIVE LEAGUES ON THREE THINGS: DO THEY NEED HIM, DOES THEIR STYLE SUIT HIM, AND WOULD IT BE A STEP UP FOR HIM?

say: Number five: Milan. He'd be an upgrade on Samuel Chukwueze, they keep the ball fifty-nine percent of the time, and they're fourth in Serie A.
cap: NUMBER FIVE: MILAN. HE'D BE AN UPGRADE ON SAMUEL CHUKWUEZE, THEY KEEP THE BALL FIFTY-NINE PERCENT OF THE TIME, AND THEY'RE FOURTH IN SERIE A.

say: Number four: Brighton. He'd be an upgrade on Maxim De Cuyper, they have almost sixty percent of the ball, and they're second in the Premier League.
cap: NUMBER FOUR: BRIGHTON. HE'D BE AN UPGRADE ON MAXIM DE CUYPER, THEY HAVE ALMOST SIXTY PERCENT OF THE BALL, AND THEY'RE SECOND IN THE PREMIER LEAGUE.

say: Number three: Tottenham. He'd be a huge upgrade on Mathys Tel, and only four clubs keep the ball more. But they're eleventh in the Premier League.
cap: NUMBER THREE: TOTTENHAM. HE'D BE A HUGE UPGRADE ON MATHYS TEL, AND ONLY FOUR CLUBS KEEP THE BALL MORE. BUT THEY'RE ELEVENTH IN THE PREMIER LEAGUE.

say: Number two: Borussia Dortmund. He'd be an upgrade on Carney Chukwuemeka, they're in the box thirty-one times a game, and they're second in the Bundesliga.
cap: NUMBER TWO: BORUSSIA DORTMUND. HE'D BE AN UPGRADE ON CARNEY CHUKWUEMEKA, THEY'RE IN THE BOX 31|thirty-one TIMES A GAME, AND THEY'RE SECOND IN THE BUNDESLIGA.

say: And number one: Arsenal. He'd be a clear upgrade on their left winger, Christos Tzolis. Only eight clubs have more of the ball. And they're top of the Premier League, with a squad worth one point four billion euros, so they could afford him. Arsenal tick every box.
